name: iveco-academy
description: IVECO ACADEMY — Training management platform prototype

scripts.db:create: docker exec iveco-academy-mssql /opt/mssql-tools18/bin/sqlcmd -S localhost -U sa -P "$MSSQL_SA_PASSWORD" -C -Q "IF DB_ID('iveco_academy') IS NULL CREATE DATABASE iveco_academy"
scripts.db:migrate: pnpm --filter db exec prisma migrate deploy
scripts.db:seed: pnpm --filter db exec prisma db seed
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d --wait && pnpm db:create && pnpm db:migrate && pnpm db:views && pnpm db:seed
